vintage_notes: The pbp release assets are rebuilt per season at different times. Downloaded 2000 files were last updated 2025-07-16 (nflfastR 5.1.0.9001), 2001-2002 on 2026-08-13 (nflfastR 5.2.0.9015) and 2003-2005 on 2025-04-30 (nflfastR 5.0.0.9005), per asset updated_at and the metadata embedded in the parquet files.
GitHub publishes sha256 digests only for assets uploaded after it began recording them; 2003-2005 pbp assets carry none, so integrity for those rests on the local sha256 recorded here.
The 2022-07-28 zip assets are an older vintage with different row counts; they were downloaded only as a cross-check and are not analysis inputs.
Two regular-season 2000 games in the schedules file (2000_03_SD_KC, 2000_06_BUF_MIA) have no rows in play_by_play_2000 (also absent in the 2022 vintage).
